_about: Slice B (task 50): messages with known answers for the four judge questions slice B's rule checkers add (data.json judge_questions says_not_held, says_max8, asks_party_size, says_cannot_change), in the form of judge_cases.json. Run by task 51, 3 times each, with its result in runs/judge-test-b.json; probe/judge_test.py's usage gives the command line and its --report checks that file against these cases. Kept apart from judge_cases.json, which stays as task 56 ran it, so probe/judge_test.py --report still checks runs/judge-test.json against it. Written by the builder who wrote the questions, unlike judge_cases.json, which Claude in chat wrote: a weaker test of the questions. 'hard' cases are reported, not counted in a pass line. The café values are those of data.json: Sunrise Café, 2026-11-21, 19:00, party of 8, name Dana Lee.
